# Brief

## Experience Goal
Keep harbor lore out of the prompt until it is relevant.

## Player Role
Anyone walking the docks.

## Characters
Mara remains the local contact.

## World
The port and its missing-ship ledger.

## Tone and Boundaries
Factual lore. No moral lecture.

## Mechanics
Keyword entries inject only when their keys appear.

## Information Reveals
The ledger text appears when ledger or ships are mentioned.

## Opening
Same tavern, if the player goes inside.

## Creative Authorization
Place names may be filled in.

## Delivery
character: json
lorebook: standalone
portrait: 
environment:
